description: High-explosive 81mm mortar cartridge, designed for use against personnel, bunkers, and light materiel targets.

variants.description: High-explosive 81mm mortar cartridge, designed for use against personnel, bunkers, and light materiel targets.  It uses a multi-option fuze.

//: 9.42 lb cartridge, with about 1.5 lb explosive filler.  Explosion power follows the 60mm Comp B scaling; casing mass is about a third of non-filler mass.

description: High-explosive 81mm mortar cartridge, designed for use against personnel, bunkers, and light materiel targets.  This one uses an impact fuze.

variants.description: High-explosive 81mm mortar cartridge, designed for use against personnel, bunkers, and light materiel targets.  It is similar to the M821A2, but uses an impact fuze.

description: A full-range 81mm M879 practice mortar cartridge, ballistically matched to M821 and M889 high-explosive rounds but fitted with an M751 practice fuze that produces only a spotting flash, bang, and smoke.

variants.description: A full-range 81mm M879 practice mortar cartridge, ballistically matched to M821 and M889 high-explosive rounds but fitted with an M751 practice fuze that produces only a spotting flash, bang, and smoke.

//: M879 Full Range Practice Cartridge: 9.1 lb, ballistically matched to M821A1/M889A1, type-classified standard in 1986.

description: An M821A2 81mm high-explosive mortar cartridge fitted with an OKSI precision guidance kit.  It retains the base round's ballistic performance, but can correct onto drone-designated targets.

description: An Advanced Capability Extended Range Mortar 81mm high-explosive cartridge with deployable glide surfaces and a semi-active laser guidance package, trading cost and complexity for a much longer winged flight profile.
